title: Certify exact precision for the ADD-retimed P104 dual
body:
## Summary

```diff
- PR2725 explicitly leaves precision transfer after ADD retiming unchecked.
+ Its exact word supports ceil(9*lambda/2)+2 fractional guard bits.
+ Seven bits suffice and are necessary at one 512-coordinate layer.
```

Adds only `research/p104-retimed-internal-grid/`, with proof, immutable sources, registered replay and a separate integer scalar oracle. This is a changed-source applicability result, not a new Clifford denominator lemma.

Credit Vasek/flyingviper's PR2725 (`71d24b655c2fdddc063b9aaf285e8425ce197499`), commdata2338's PR2662, ywz65's PR2586, Ross Richardson's [sharp-grid finding](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2750#discussioncomment-18959185), PR2772/2754, Arham Tahir and the retained native/P104 lineage. Original source notices are preserved. [Canonical claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2750#discussioncomment-18960305).

Started from canonical main `bf8db3a1c7c7da2cae0fd5a77ca228cdd2664a53`, priority revision 5. Submission refresh reached `381fa07cb60fb47ceccfc353cc2891b4d17078c3`; guidance, selected record and relevant inputs were unchanged. Fresh overlap covered 721 open PRs and 1,457 Discussion records with complete reported pagination. Coverage limitations and exact pins are in TASK.json/SOURCES.json.

## Evidence

- Before, the unchanged-word grid certificate did not bind the changed transport/frame lifetimes. Actual six-bit execution rejects an inexact internal halving.
- After, two complete seven-bit executions each match 183,296 complex endpoint coordinates and erase all eight private fields. All 1,940 native occurrences bind; a separate integer interpreter confirms all 30,007 pre-add products. Seven semantic faults reject.
- Registered replay, five package test groups, 74 research-workflow tests, Ruff E/F/B, warning-as-error compilation and optimized replay of the exact staged Git export pass on CPython 3.12.15/Linux.

```sh
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-retimed-internal-grid
```

## Merge Danger

Door: two-way. Blast radius: research.

Native/chart correctness and tensor lifting remain inherited; physical fixtures cover one layer. No native compiler regeneration, full selected replay, hosted CI or formal-kernel/human review is claimed. Recursive representation costs, hosting, idle/residual charges and supplier admission remain open. The credited PR2744/2741 consumer-budget objections remain. No new supplier, kappa or selected-frontier change.
